intended_object: Take a continuous map f : X → Y, a sheaf of abelian groups G on X, and q > 0. The definition is a natural isomorphism between two presheaves on Y. The first sends V to Hᵠ(f⁻¹V, G). The second sends V to the q-th homology of the pushforward along f of a fixed canonical injective resolution of G, evaluated at V. This is read off the docstring and the type signature.
explanation:
The definition does not define a standard mathematical notion. It is a specific comparison isomorphism (`NatIso.ofComponents`) built from previously proved pointwise isomorphisms and a naturality lemma. Mathematically it is a step in the proof of the standard fact that Rᵠf_*G is the sheafification of the presheaf V ↦ Hᵠ(f⁻¹V, G).

The library uses it that way. In `OpenCohomologyRightDerived.lean`, it is sheafified and composed with other isomorphisms to identify the higher direct images. Its `_hom_coefficient_naturality` lemmas supply the naturality needed there.

It packages proof data and is a statement rather than an object, so I classify it as an auxiliary technical construction.
